question: What is the average score in writing for the schools that were opened after 1991 or closed before 2000? List the school names along with the score. Also, list the communication number of the schools if there is any.
evidence: Communication number refers to phone number.

    AVG(sc.AvgScrWrite) AS AvgScoreInWriting,
    s.Phone AS CommunicationNumber
FROM 
    schools s
INNER JOIN 
    satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
WHERE 
    (s.OpenDate > '1991-01-01' OR s.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01')
GROUP BY 
    s.School, s.Phone

WHERE 
    (s.OpenDate > '1991-01-01' OR s.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01')

question: Consider the average difference between K-12 enrollment and 15-17 enrollment of schools that are locally funded, list the names and DOC type of schools which has a difference above this average.
evidence: Difference between K-12 enrollment and 15-17 enrollment can be computed by `Enrollment (K-12)` - `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`

candidates.sql:
SELECT 
  s.School, 
  s.DOCType 
FROM 
  schools s 
  INNER JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode 
WHERE 
  f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 
  ( 
    SELECT 
      AVG(f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) 
    FROM 
      frpm f 
      INNER JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode 
    WHERE 
      s.FundingType = 'Local' 
  ) 
  AND s.FundingType = 'Local'

SELECT 
    T1.School, 
    T1.DOCType, 
    (T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS EnrollmentDifference
FROM 
    schools T1
INNER JOIN 
    frpm T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE 
    T1.FundingType = 'Local' AND 
    (T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
        SELECT 
            AVG(T3.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T3.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
        FROM 
            frpm T3
        INNER JOIN 
            schools T4 ON T3.CDSCode = T4.CDSCode
        WHERE 
            T4.FundingType = 'Local'
    )
ORDER BY 
    EnrollmentDifference DESC

SELECT s.School, s.DOCType
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Local' AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > (
    SELECT AVG(f1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
    FROM frpm f1
    JOIN schools s1 ON f1.CDSCode = s1.CDSCode
    WHERE s1.FundingType = 'Local'
)

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.DOCType
FROM 
    schools s
INNER JOIN 
    frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE 
    s.FundingType = 'Local'
    AND (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
        SELECT AVG(EnrollmentDiff)
        FROM (
            SELECT 
                f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS EnrollmentDiff
            FROM 
                frpm f
            INNER JOIN 
                schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
            WHERE 
                s.FundingType = 'Local'
        ) AS avg_diff
    )

SELECT 
  T1.School, 
  T1.DOCType
FROM 
  schools T1
INNER JOIN 
  frpm T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE 
  T1.FundingType = 'Local' 
  AND (T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
    SELECT 
      AVG(T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
    FROM 
      schools T1
    INNER JOIN 
      frpm T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
    WHERE 
      T1.FundingType = 'Local'
  )

SELECT 
    s.School, 
    s.DOCType 
FROM 
    schools s
INNER JOIN 
    frpm f 
ON 
    s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE 
    s.FundingType = 'Locally Funded' 
    AND (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
        SELECT 
            AVG(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) 
        FROM 
            frpm f2
        INNER JOIN 
            schools s2 
        ON 
            f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
        WHERE 
            s2.FundingType = 'Locally Funded'
    )

WITH EnrollmentDifference AS (
    SELECT 
        frpm.CDSCode,
        frpm.`School Name` AS School,
        frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` - frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS EnrollmentDiff,
        schools.`Funding Type` AS FundingType
    FROM 
        frpm
    INNER JOIN 
        schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
    WHERE 
        schools.`Funding Type` = 'Locally Funded'
),
AverageEnrollmentDifference AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(EnrollmentDiff) AS AvgEnrollmentDiff
    FROM 
        EnrollmentDifference
)
SELECT 
    ed.School,
    ed.FundingType
FROM 
    EnrollmentDifference ed
CROSS JOIN 
    AverageEnrollmentDifference aed
WHERE 
    ed.EnrollmentDiff > aed.AvgEnrollmentDiff

SELECT s.School, s.DOCType
FROM frpm f
INNER JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally Funded'
  AND (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
    SELECT AVG(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS AvgDiff
    FROM frpm f2
    INNER JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
    WHERE s2.FundingType = 'Locally Funded'
  )

question: Under whose administration does the school with the highest number of test takers whose total SAT Scores are greater or equal to 1500 belong to? Indicate his or her full name.
evidence: full name means first name, last name; There are at most 3 administrators for each school; SAT Scores are greater or equal to 1500 refers to NumGE1500

candidates.sql:
SELECT 
    AdmFName1 || ' ' || AdmLName1 AS AdministratorName
FROM 
    schools
WHERE 
    CDSCode = (
        SELECT 
            cds
        FROM 
            satscores
        WHERE 
            NumGE1500 = (
                SELECT 
                    MAX(NumGE1500)
                FROM 
                    satscores
            )
        ORDER BY 
            NumTstTakr DESC
        LIMIT 1
    )

SELECT 
    s.AdmFName1 || ' ' || s.AdmLName1 AS FullName
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE 
    ss.NumGE1500 >= 1500

question: What is the ratio in percentage of Santa Clara County schools that are locally funded compared to all other types of charter school funding?
evidence: Ratio in percentage = (count(locally funded schools in Santa Clara) / count(all funding type schools in Santa Clara) * 100%

candidates.sql:
SELECT 
    (CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN FundingType = 'Local' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) / 
     CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN FundingType IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL)) * 100 AS LocalFundingRatio
FROM 
    schools
WHERE 
    County = 'Santa Clara'

SELECT 
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN frpm."Charter Funding Type" = 'Locally Funded' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) * 100.0 / COUNT(frpm."CDSCode")) AS Ratio
FROM 
    frpm
INNER JOIN 
    schools ON frpm."CDSCode" = schools.CDSCode
WHERE 
    schools.County = 'Santa Clara'

SELECT 
    (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1."Charter Funding Type" = 'Locally Funded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1."Charter Funding Type")) AS Ratio
FROM 
    frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN 
    schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE 
    T2.County = 'Santa Clara'

SELECT 
  (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.County = 'Santa Clara' AND T1."Charter Funding Type" = 'Locally Funded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / 
   SUM(CASE WHEN T2.County = 'Santa Clara' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100 AS RatioInPercentage
FROM 
  frpm T1
  INNER JOIN schools T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode

SELECT 
    (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Charter = 1 AND T2.FundingType = 'Locally Funded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / 
     SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Charter = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100 AS Ratio
FROM 
    satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN 
    schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE 
    T2.County = 'Santa Clara'

SELECT 
    (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN FundingType = 'Locally Funded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / 
     SUM(CASE WHEN FundingType <> 'Locally Funded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS Ratio
FROM 
    schools
WHERE 
    County = 'Santa Clara' AND Charter = 1

SELECT 
    (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.County = 'Santa Clara' AND T1.FundingType = 'Local' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / 
     SUM(CASE WHEN T1.County = 'Santa Clara' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100 AS Ratio
FROM 
    schools T1
JOIN 
    frpm T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode

WITH SantaClaraSchools AS (
    SELECT 
        CDSCode,
        FundingType
    FROM 
        schools

        County = 'Santa Clara'
        AND Charter = 1
),
LocallyFundedCount AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS LocallyFundedCount
    FROM 
        SantaClaraSchools
    WHERE 
        FundingType = 'Locally Funded'
),
TotalCharterCount AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS TotalCharterCount
    FROM 
        SantaClaraSchools
)
SELECT 
    (CAST(LocallyFundedCount AS REAL) / TotalCharterCount) * 100 AS Ratio

  SELECT 
    p.player_name, 
    AVG(pa.finishing) AS avg_finishing
  FROM 
    Player p
  INNER JOIN 
    Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_fifa_api_id = pa.player_fifa_api_id
  GROUP BY 
    p.player_name
),
HeightRankCTE AS (
  SELECT 
    p.player_name, 
    p.height,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY p.height DESC) AS height_rank_desc,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY p.height ASC) AS height_rank_asc
  FROM 
    Player p
)
SELECT 
  pf.player_name
FROM 
  PlayerFinishingCTE pf
INNER JOIN 
  HeightRankCTE hr ON pf.player_name = hr.player_name
WHERE 
  hr.height_rank_desc = 1 OR hr.height_rank_asc = 1
ORDER BY 
  pf.avg_finishing DESC
LIMIT 1

      UNION
      SELECT MIN(height) FROM Player
    )
